newsitem.title: USA: Summers, Sakakibara discuss rates, hold poicy--US.
newsitem.headline: Summers, Sakakibara discuss rates, hold poicy--US.

text.p: Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers and Japanese Vice Finance Minister for International Affairs Eisuke Sakakibara discussed exchange rates at a brief meeting, but made no changes in current policy, a U.S. Treasury spokeswoman said on Wednesday.

She said the scheduled meeting, which lasted about an hour and a half, also covered the currency crisis in Thailand for which the International Monetary Fund has set up a $16 billion loan package with a $4 billion contribution from Japan.
"They discussed a range of issues, including the U.S.-Japan relationship, events in Thailand and financial cooperation in Asia," the spokeswoman said.
"They discussed exchange rates as part of their discussion on the U.S.-Japan relationship," she said, adding that the meeting had produced no changes in the countries' current exchange rate policies.
The spokeswoman declined to comment on the substance of discussions at the meeting, the first between the two men since Sakakibara became vice minister of finance.
